import asyncio
from aiohttp import web

async def test():
    # In 3.14.0, HTTP/1.1 requests without valid Host header are rejected with 400
    app = web.Application()
    
    async def handler(request):
        return web.Response(text='ok')
    
    app.router.add_get('/', handler)
    runner = web.AppRunner(app)
    await runner.setup()
    site = web.TCPSite(runner, '127.0.0.1', 8080)
    await site.start()
    port = site._server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]
    
    # Create raw connection and send HTTP/1.1 request without Host header
    import socket
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    sock.connect(('127.0.0.1', port))
    sock.sendall(b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n')
    response = sock.recv(4096)
    sock.close()
    
    # In 3.14.0, this returns 400 Bad Request
    assert b'400' in response
    
    await runner.cleanup()

asyncio.run(test())

import asyncio
from aiohttp import web
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock

async def test():
    # In 3.13.5, HTTP/1.1 requests without Host header were accepted
    app = web.Application()
    
    async def handler(request):
        return web.Response(text='ok')
    
    app.router.add_get('/', handler)
    runner = web.AppRunner(app)
    await runner.setup()
    site = web.TCPSite(runner, '127.0.0.1', 8080)
    await site.start()
    port = site._server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]
    
    # Create raw connection and send HTTP/1.1 request without Host header
    import socket
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    sock.connect(('127.0.0.1', port))
    sock.sendall(b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n')
    response = sock.recv(4096)
    sock.close()
    
    # In 3.13.5, this would return 200
    assert b'200' in response or b'400' not in response
    
    await runner.cleanup()

asyncio.run(test())
